Colonoscopy, 24 Oct 2024. Dictated by Dr. Omar Al Shamsi; transcribed 24 Oct 2024.

This 49-year-old woman was referred from primary care with a positive FIT. Sedation: midazolam 3 mg and pethidine 25 mg IV. Bowel preparation was with Moviprep (split dose). The colonoscope was advanced to the caecum, identified by the appendiceal orifice and ileocaecal valve; photo-documentation was obtained. The withdrawal time was 8 minutes.

There was sigmoid diverticulosis. A 3 mm sessile (Paris 0-Is) polyp in the caecum was resected with cold biopsy forceps and retrieved for histology (pot 1). A 9 mm semi-pedunculated (Paris 0-Isp) polyp in the descending colon was resected with cold snare and retrieved for histology (pot 2).

Specimens: pot 1 - caecum polyp, 3 mm; pot 2 - descending colon polyp, 9 mm. No complications.

IMPRESSION:
2 polyps removed (descending colon, caecum). Sigmoid diverticulosis.

PLAN:
Surveillance interval to be decided once histology is available.

ADDENDUM 30 Oct 2024 - pathology received. pot 1 (caecum polyp, 3 mm) - Tubular adenoma with low-grade dysplasia; pot 2 (descending colon polyp, 9 mm) - Tubular adenoma with low-grade dysplasia.

Electronically signed: Dr. Omar Al Shamsi, 24 Oct 2024 14:40

This 65-year-old man was referred after a positive fecal immunochemical test (364 µg/g) on screening. The procedure was performed under propofol sedation administered by the anesthesiologist. Bowel preparation was with low-residue diet x2 days + split-dose Moviprep. The cecum was reached (transillumination in the right iliac fossa; appendiceal orifice photographed). The withdrawal time was 8 minutes.

There was mild melanosis coli. A 6 mm sessile (Paris 0-Is) polyp in the cecum was resected with cold snare and retrieved for histology (pot 1). In the rectum there was a 6 mm sessile (Paris 0-Is) polyp, removed by cold snare and retrieved (pot 2). In the sigmoid colon there was a 10 mm pedunculated (Paris 0-Ip) polyp, removed by hot snare (prophylactic clip applied) and retrieved (pot 3).

Specimens: pot 1 - cecum polyp, 6 mm; pot 2 - rectum polyp, 6 mm; pot 3 - sigmoid colon polyp, 10 mm. There was minor immediate bleeding at a polypectomy site, controlled with one clip.

IMPRESSION:
3 polyps removed (rectum, sigmoid colon, cecum). Melanosis coli.

Await histology.

Positive FIT (national bowel cancer screening programme).

Conscious sedation was given with midazolam 2 mg and fentanyl 50 micrograms intravenously.

The quality of the bowel preparation (Klean-Prep 4 L) was adequate with some washing required.

EXTENT REACHED
The colonoscope was advanced to the caecum, identified by the appendiceal orifice and ileocaecal valve; photo-documentation was obtained.

A 3 mm sessile polyp (NICE 2, likely adenoma) in the sigmoid colon was resected with cold biopsy forceps and retrieved for histology (pot 2). A 4 mm semi-pedunculated (Paris 0-Isp) polyp in the caecum was resected with cold snare and retrieved for histology (pot 3).

SPECIMENS
Specimens: pot 1 - sigmoid colon polyp, 2 mm; pot 2 - sigmoid colon polyp, 3 mm; pot 3 - caecum polyp, 4 mm; pot 4 - transverse colon biopsies.

ADVERSE EVENTS
There were no immediate complications.

IMPRESSION
3 polyps removed (sigmoid colon, caecum). Probable adenoma(s) on optical assessment. Focal transverse colitis - biopsied. Transverse colon lipoma (not sampled).

FOLLOW-UP
Surveillance interval to be decided once histology is available.
